source.name: Capital One Newsroom
source.quote: Today, Capital One and Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE) announced the next chapter for Capital One Arena, extending their long-term naming rights partnership
source.note: Announcement of the extension (11 August 2026); the earlier naming rights run back to the arena’s renaming, so the start date in this record is still open.

note: Arena naming rights: Capital One Arena.
